description: Summary figure and architecture table comparing Mff-repeat motifs, predicted coiled coil and tail anchor in human MFF, Drosophila Tango11, and C. elegans MFF-1/MFF-2
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
S=requests.Session()
def getseq(a):
    r=S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    return ''.join(r.text.split('\n')[1:])
P={'Hs MFF (Q9GZY8)':'Q9GZY8','Dm Tango11 (Q961C9)':'Q961C9','Ce MFF-1 (Q19343)':'Q19343','Ce MFF-2 (P91344)':'P91344'}
seqs={k:getseq(v) for k,v in P.items()}

AAs='ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY'; idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
seed=['RVPEKLKV','QVPERIVV','LVPERIVI','HVPERIIV','EVPERIVV','EVPERIVI','NVPDRIVV']; L=8
pssm=np.zeros((L,20))
for p in range(L):
    c=np.ones(20)*0.5
    for s in seed: c[idx[s[p]]]+=1
    pssm[p]=np.log2((c/c.sum())/0.05)
def scan(s): return [(i+1,s[i:i+L],sum(pssm[p][idx[ch]] for p,ch in enumerate(s[i:i+L]))) for i in range(len(s)-L+1)]
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def kd(s,w=19): return np.array([np.mean([KD[c] for c in s[i:i+w]]) for i in range(len(s)-w+1)])

# AlphaFold pLDDT + helix
af={}
for lbl,acc in P.items():
    r=S.get(f'https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}',timeout=90)
    pdb=S.get(r.json()[0]['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text
    ca={int(l[22:26]):(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
        for l in pdb.split('\n') if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA'}
    res=np.array(sorted(ca)); xyz=np.array([ca[i][:3] for i in res]); pl=np.array([ca[i][3] for i in res])
    hel=np.zeros(len(res),bool)
    for k in range(len(res)-4):
        d=np.linalg.norm(xyz[k+4]-xyz[k])
        if 4.5<=d<=6.5: hel[k:k+5]=True
    af[lbl]=(res,pl,hel)

THR=10.96
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,11),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.25,1,1]})

# --- Panel A: architecture ---
ax=axes[0]; ax.set_xlim(-10,360); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,len(P)-0.4); ax.invert_yaxis()
for yi,(lbl,s) in enumerate(seqs.items()):
    n=len(s)
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,yi-0.16),n,0.32,fc='#E8E8EC',ec='#9aa0a6',lw=0.8))
    # repeats
    hits=sorted(scan(s),key=lambda x:-x[2])[:4]; kept=[]
    for h in hits:
        if h[2]>6.5 and all(abs(h[0]-j[0])>=L for j in kept): kept.append(h)
    for pos,w,sc in kept:
        col='#2E6F9E' if sc>THR else '#8FB8D6'
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((pos-1,yi-0.16),L,0.32,fc=col,ec='none'))
        ax.text(pos+L/2,yi-0.26,f'{w}\n{sc:.1f}',ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=6.6,color='#1b3d57')
    # TM from hydropathy peak
    h=kd(s); t=int(np.argmax(h))+1
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((t-1,yi-0.16),19,0.32,fc='#B4452F',ec='none'))
    ax.text(t+9,yi+0.33,'TM',ha='center',va='top',fontsize=7,color='#B4452F')
    # coiled-coil = confident long helix immediately before TM (AlphaFold)
    res,pl,hel=af[lbl]
    k=t-1
    j=k
    while j>0 and hel[max(0,j-1)]: j-=1
    if t-1-j>=10:
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j,yi-0.16),t-1-j,0.32,fc='#D9A441',ec='none'))
        ax.text((j+t-1)/2,yi+0.33,f'pred. coiled coil {j+1}-{t-1}',ha='center',va='top',fontsize=7,color='#8a6a16')
    ax.text(-8,yi,lbl,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel('residue')
ax.set_title('A. MFF-family architecture: Mff/Drp1-binding repeats (blue, PSSM score), predicted coiled coil (gold), tail-anchor TM (red)',
             fontsize=10,loc='left')
for sp in ['top','right','left']: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel B: PSSM profile ---
ax=axes[1]
cols={'Hs MFF (Q9GZY8)':'#1b3d57','Dm Tango11 (Q961C9)':'#6a8f3b','Ce MFF-1 (Q19343)':'#B4452F','Ce MFF-2 (P91344)':'#D9A441'}
for lbl,s in seqs.items():
    sc=np.array([x[2] for x in scan(s)])
    ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(sc)+1),sc,lw=1.3,color=cols[lbl],label=lbl)
ax.axhline(THR,ls='--',c='k',lw=0.9)
ax.text(300,THR+0.5,'empirical p = 1e-4 threshold',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('residue (start of 8-mer window)'); ax.set_ylabel('Mff-repeat PSSM score (bits)')
ax.set_title('B. Mff-repeat motif (xVPEx[ILV]xV) score profile, Met1 position excluded from the PSSM',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax.set_xlim(0,360)
for sp in ['top','right']: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel C: AlphaFold pLDDT ---
ax=axes[2]
for lbl in seqs:
    res,pl,hel=af[lbl]
    ax.plot(res,pl,lw=1.2,color=cols[lbl],label=lbl)
ax.axhline(70,ls=':',c='grey',lw=1); ax.text(302,71,'pLDDT 70',fontsize=8,color='grey')
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT'); ax.set_xlim(0,360); ax.set_ylim(20,100)
ax.set_title('C. AlphaFold DB confidence: the C-terminal coiled-coil + tail-anchor helix is the best-ordered part of every ortholog',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc='upper left')
for sp in ['top','right']: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# provenance table
rows=[]
for lbl,s in seqs.items():
    hits=sorted(scan(s),key=lambda x:-x[2])[:4]; kept=[]
    for h in hits:
        if h[2]>6.5 and all(abs(h[0]-j[0])>=L for j in kept): kept.append(h)
    h=kd(s); t=int(np.argmax(h))+1
    rows.append({'protein':lbl,'length':len(s),
                 'repeats_above_p1e-4':sum(1 for x in kept if x[2]>THR),
                 'repeat_calls':'; '.join(f'{p}:{w}({sc:.1f})' for p,w,sc in sorted(kept)),
                 'TM_pred':f'{t}-{t+18}','TM_seq':s[t-1:t+18],'C_term_after_TM':s[t+18:],
                 'AF_long_Cterm_helix':f"{int(af[lbl][0][np.argmax(af[lbl][2])])}" })
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows); tab.to_csv('mff_architecture_table.csv',index=False)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
